svg.title: lapanda: A Matrix-Free Differentiable Solver for Nonconvex Constrained Optimization Layers
svg.desc: An augmented-Lagrangian outer loop calls PANDA subproblem solves; the backward pass approximates optimizer sensitivities with matrix-free operators. Combines general constraints with matrix-free forward and backward computation. Motion illustrates algorithm steps or system behavior; it does not reproduce reported numerical results.
